title: Feature Request: Allow native tools to be disabled
body: Some MCP servers, such as [Clojure MCP](https://github.com/bhauman/clojure-mcp), replace the existing tools in Claude Code with more specialized functionality. In this case we want to disable the built-in Claude Code tools, but still use the `claude` CLI. The easiest alternative right now is to use Claude Desktop instead.
author: rads
